description: Bell H-1H FAB 8701 (built 1967, to Brazil 1997), donated by the Ministry of Defence and inaugurated as the Armed Forces monument on 30 Dec 2016; removed by the base on 4 Jul 2023 for repainting with the promise of return, and listed back at the roundabout in a Feb 2026 compilation.
museum_name: Rotatória Fernando Ferrari H-1H Monument, Santa Maria
